name: one-small-girl-nervous
style: Solo child vocal: one shy seven-year-old girl singing alone, untrained, breathy, mouth close to the mic, hesitant on each entry, drifting flat on the high notes yet holding the tune bravely. Quiet chamber organ on a single soft stopped-flute stop, plain four-part hymn chords trailing behind her, free rubato, slowing when she slows. Primary school service in a small hall, dry close-miked fly-on-the-wall recording, unpolished. Slow 3/4. Organ lets go after her final word, then silence.
exclude: choir, children's choir, backing vocals, vocal harmonies, polished vocals, autotune, reverb, cathedral reverb, drums, percussion, strings, piano, bass
lyrics:
[Verse: the girl alone, organ barely there, following her]
We can't afford a bed for you,
The purse is far too thin;
[she slows, the organ waits for her]
There is room on all those islands,
But you will sleep in a bin.
[End: organ chord lifts off after her last word, nothing after]
